platform: Camaradio 101.3 One-Song Download-Link or Upload Submission Form
manual_review_reason: Camaradio's official first-party form authorizes one song for possible airplay through either a permissioned downloadable file link or a direct WAV/MP3 upload. Direct uploads must be 44.1 or 48 kHz, 16-bit stereo and under 10 MB. The form requires artist and contact data, location and release details, a rights and broadcast authorization affirmation, and a changing arithmetic human-verification challenge. A human must confirm international eligibility, ownership and broadcast rights, explicit-content and AI-origin rules, select exactly one suitable MarcsMusic track, validate the file or link, complete the CAPTCHA personally and submit manually. Do not automate the form or solve the CAPTCHA. Stop if authentication, payment, additional consent, session or other protected controls appear.
